meta.setting: exp1 = V2 at 100% labels, 3873 Concorde features, as results/lambda_sweep_nod3
meta.measurement: mean per-batch cosine of raw gradients on all full training batches of one extra shuffle, in train mode, RNG and BN buffers restored; epoch 0 = initialization
meta.cos_task_hinge: L_mono with relu instead of softplus (acts only on actual violations)
meta.norm_total: norm of the sum of lam_i * grad_i over the trained terms
meta.test_mono_viol: monotonicity violation rate (%), FP or SP increases or BP decreases from Decode to Commit by > 0.01
meta.test_base_incons: cross-stage Base inconsistency (%), (max-min)/mean of the 4 predicted Base values, averaged over samples
